title: DANIEL
subtitle: the night the lions didn't eat

lines.say: [scared] [whispers] Selah... was that a LION?!
[calmly] Relax. Lions only eat people who annoy them.
cap: Lions only eat people who {o:annoy them}.

lines.say: [panicked] I annoy EVERYONE!
[warmly] Then you'll like this one. A man once spent a whole night with them.
cap: A man once spent a {r:whole night} with them.

lines.say: [storytelling] Everyone pictures Daniel as a young hero.
cap: Everyone pictures {g:Daniel} as a young hero.

lines.say: But by now, he was an old man. Probably over eighty.
cap: But by now, he was an {o:old man}.

lines.say: He'd served kings for sixty years. And the new king, Darius, trusted him more than anyone.
[ominous] The other officials were jealous. They dug for a scandal... and found nothing.
[sly] [whispers] We'll never catch him... unless it has something to do with his God.
cap: unless it has something to do with his {r:God}.”

lines.say: So they tricked the king into a new law. For thirty days, pray to no one but the king. Or be thrown to the lions.
cap: So they tricked the king into a new {r:law}.
For thirty days, pray to no one but the king.

lines.say: [outraged] THIRTY DAYS?!
[softly] Daniel heard about the law. He went home... and opened his windows toward Jerusalem.
And he prayed. Three times a day. Just like he always had.
[whispers] He didn't even close the window?
[proudly] He didn't even close the window.
cap: He didn't even close the window.

lines.say: They caught him, of course. And the king realized... he'd been tricked.
cap: And the king realized... he'd been {r:tricked}.

lines.say: He tried all day to save Daniel. But the law of the Medes and Persians could never be changed.
cap: He tried {o:all day} to save Daniel.
But the law of the Medes and Persians

lines.say: [anguished] [softly] Daniel... may your God, whom you serve continually... rescue you.
[ominous] They threw him in. And sealed the stone.
[softly] That night, the king couldn't eat. Couldn't sleep.
cap: That night, the king couldn't eat.

lines.say: [building] At the first light of dawn... he ran to the den.
cap: At the first light of dawn...

lines.say: [desperate] [shouting] Daniel! Has your God been able to save you?!
cap: Has your God been able to {g:save you}?!”

lines.say: [calmly] O king, live forever. My God sent his angel... and shut the lions' mouths.
[shouting] [overjoyed] HE'S ALIVE!
[warmly] Not a scratch on him. Because he trusted his God.
[thinking] But why not just pray quietly for a month? With the window shut?
cap: But why not just pray quietly for a month?

lines.say: [warmly] Because Daniel didn't become faithful the day of the test.
He'd prayed at that window for sixty years. The lions didn't make him faithful... they just showed it.
cap: He'd prayed at that window for {g:sixty years}.
The lions didn't make him faithful...

lines.say: [tenderly] What you do every day... is who you'll be on your hardest night.
cap: is who you'll be on your {g:hardest night}.

lines.say: [thoughtful] ...So I should pray more?
[gently] You could start now.
[softly] Dear God... thank you for Selah... and please, no lions—
cap: Dear God... thank you for Selah...
